Card Members are responsible for the costs charged by third-party service providers.‡Baggage Insurance Plan♦Travel more comfortably knowing you can be covered for lost, damaged, or stolen Baggage when you purchase the Entire Fare for a Common Carrier Vehicle ticket (e.g. plane, train, ship, or bus) on an Eligible Card. Coverage can be provided for up to $1,250 for carry-on Baggage and up to $500 for checked Baggage, in excess of coverage provided by the Common Carrier. For New York State residents, there is a $10,000 aggregate maximum limit for all Covered Persons per Covered Trip. Please read important exclusions and restrictions.Trip Delay InsuranceBooking the trip is easy. Avoiding delays is next to impossible. Accept the CardIf you choose to accept the Card, the information we provide to the credit bureau(s) may impact your credit score.More fromFrequently Asked Questions about the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® CardWhat is the annual fee for the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card?The annual fee for the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card is $250.¤ There is no annual fee for Additional Cards.What are some of the benefits of the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card?With the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card, you can earn:Card Members can earn 6X points on each dollar of eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy®.‡Card Members can earn 4X points at restaurants worldwide, and at U.S Supermarkets (up to $15,000 in combined purchases at restaurants and U.S. supermarkets per calendar year, then 2X points).‡Card Members can earn 2X points on all other eligible purchases.‡The Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card offers a suite of benefits such as, but not limited to:Marriott Bonvoy® 1K Bonus Points Per Stay: Earn 1,000 Marriott Bonvoy® bonus points per paid eligible stay booked directly with Marriott for properties participating in Marriott Bonvoy. Award can be used for one night (redemption level at or under 50,000 Marriott Bonvoy® points) at a participating hotel.‡*Certain hotels have resort fees.Does the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card have foreign transaction fees?The Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card does not have foreign transaction fees.
